_readme: Prospective candidates registered AFTER the frozen inference-v1 cohort began (2026-10-05).

research-v1-2026-10-05 fingerprints hypotheses.json, its 28 planned tests, the engine files and the single 2027-07-02 look; nothing may be added to that family mid-cohort. These ideas live here instead and can only be promoted by a FUTURE, separately frozen inference version.
Tracking only. prospective_tracker.py records features and outcomes and reports counts; it never changes selection, exits, sizing or any file the bot trades from.

Evidence = qualifiers whose scan_date is on or after the registration date. Rows before that date are 'pre_registration' context: definitions were chosen after seeing how often each feature occurs, but before any outcome of those rows was read.
Owner decision 2026-10-22: 'yes write them down and monitor' (source: Options Insight / Imran Lakha emails, full read in orca-bot/LAKHA_EMAILS_LEDGER_2026-10-22.md).
population: Every Tier A qualifier row in tier_a_paths (written weekly by path_labels.py). Features are read from skew_daily on exchange sessions only (market_time), at the signal date and at the session exactly 9 sessions earlier, the start of Tier A's 9-session window.
outcome: hit_t1: 1 if the labelled path resolved at the +10% target, 0 if at the -7% stop. OPEN rows are censored and excluded from rates until they resolve.

read_plan.decision_rule: At the decision read, for each hypothesis: hit-rate difference (feature yes minus feature no) on resolved prospective rows, Fisher exact one-sided p < 0.025 (family alpha 0.05 over 2 tests), AND an observed gap of at least min_effect_pts, AND the sign must agree in both chronological halves. Interim looks print rates only; they can never issue READY and never change a rule.
read_plan.power_note: Simulated for this exact rule (Fisher one-sided p < 0.025, observed gap >= 15 points, positive in both halves) at 160 resolved rows, a 38-40% feature share and a 46% overall hit rate, 4,000 runs each: a true 10-point gap passes about 18% of the time, 15 points about 40%, 20 points about 64%, 25 points about 82%; no real gap passes about 1%. Qualifiers arrived at about 8 a month from late March to mid-October 2026 but about 5 a month from mid-July to mid-October, so 160 resolved rows take about 20 to 32 months (roughly mid-2028 to mid-2029) and the first look at 40 about 5 to 8 months (roughly April to July 2027). A smaller true effect may stay undecided; then the hypothesis is retired as 'not demonstrated', not extended or re-tuned.
read_plan.failure_statement: If the decision read does not meet the rule, the hypothesis is retired with these exact definitions and is not re-opened with new thresholds, windows or outcome definitions.
read_plan.power_note_correction: 2026-10-23, before any prospective row existed: the first version claimed about 70% power at a 20-point gap, about 90% at 25 points, and 18-24 months. That came from a plain two-proportion approximation that ignored the 15-point and both-halves conditions, and from the faster spring signal pace. Re-simulated; decision_rule now names min_effect_pts explicitly, as the registration commit message stated. At 160 rows a significant gap is already about 16 points, so that wording changes nothing in practice. Definitions, population, outcome, thresholds and read points are unchanged.

hypotheses.source: Options Insight email 2026-02-20 (IBM): the stock crashed through its put wall but the wall did not roll lower, so the options positioning was not confirming more downside; read as supportive.
hypotheses.definition: p1_wall_held = 1 if put_wall_strike on the signal date >= put_wall_strike 9 sessions earlier (the wall did NOT roll down during the washout), 0 if it rolled lower. Blank if either wall is missing or zero.
hypotheses.prediction: Qualifiers with p1_wall_held = 1 hit the target more often than qualifiers with 0.
hypotheses.prevalence_check_2026-10-22: 47 past qualifiers with both readings: held 19, rolled 28 (median roll -9%). Outcomes were not read when this was chosen.

hypotheses.source: Options Insight email 2026-09-03 (Jason Ruschel): large OPENING put sales, volume above open interest at a strike and large for the name, mean someone with a balance sheet committed to own the stock there; the level then behaves like support.
hypotheses.definition: We have no flow feed, so this is a PROXY: p2_put_sale_footprint = 1 if put_wall_oi on the signal date > put_wall_oi 9 sessions earlier AND put_25d_iv on the signal date < put_25d_iv 9 sessions earlier (puts were added while their price fell, i.e. net sellers), else 0. Blank if any input is missing. The wall strike may differ between the two dates; the comparison is between each day's own wall.
hypotheses.prediction: Qualifiers with p2_put_sale_footprint = 1 hit the target more often than qualifiers with 0.
hypotheses.prevalence_check_2026-10-22: 47 past qualifiers: footprint 18, not 29. The one-day put_wall_oi_change field is <= 0 for every past qualifier (apparently filtered upstream), so the 9-session window comparison is used instead. Outcomes were not read when this was chosen.

P1_put_wall_held_through_washout.verdict: tracking; no verdict is possible before the decision read

P2_opening_put_sale_footprint.verdict: tracking; no verdict is possible before the decision read
